title: Background Images
definition: Utilities for controlling an element's background image, size, position, and repeating.
simpleExplanation: When you want an image to act as the 'wallpaper' for a div, rather than using an `` tag. You then use `bg-cover` to make sure it fills the div without stretching, and `bg-center` to focus on the middle of the image.
realWorldExample: A massive Hero Banner at the top of a webpage featuring a beautiful stock photo spanning the full width of the browser.

basic: What class guarantees a background image will fill the entire container without distorting its aspect ratio?
intermediate: How do you apply a specific image URL in Tailwind without modifying the `tailwind.config.js`?

answers.question: Specific image URL?
answers.answer: You can use Tailwind's arbitrary value syntax: `bg-[url('/img/hero.jpg')]`.
